control._why: Leatherhead starts with hexproof and breaks artifacts/enchantments; Surrak can't be countered; Clarion Conqueror shuts off planeswalker and artifact abilities; Arachne taxes their spells. Cuts fight/removal with few targets.

midrange._why: Bigger threats and more removal for a creature fight; cuts the weakest early drops.

aggro._why: Doorkeeper Thrull is a flash flier that stops enter-the-battlefield value; Erode kills a threat. Cuts the mana creature and weakest early drops.

graveyard._why: Added 2026-11-26: their best against graveyard-based aggro decks (graveyard hate, cards that stop enter triggers, cheap removal, sweepers). Doorkeeper Thrull stops enter triggers and blocks fliers; cheap exile and removal.
